Temporary runtime stack memory for clock sysvar, BPF migration, and stake reward calculations.

# Purpose
`fd_runtime_stack.h` defines the `fd_runtime_stack_t` union, which provides temporary stack memory for runtime slot-level work. It groups separate staging areas for clock sysvar vote-account sorting, BPF program migration, and stake and reward calculations. Each union member contains fixed-size arrays and temporary account objects used by the replay tile during short-lived runtime operations. The header also includes the type and constant definitions needed to size these buffers and to use the related runtime data types.
